resources.string: Optional unverified Instagram diagnostic. With fresh report consent, Doom traverses only an Instagram accessibility root and keeps one bounded sanitized structural report containing static Instagram resource names (64 unique tokens, 8,192 ASCII characters). A separate default-off diagnostic consent shows a five-second accessibility overlay on the first verified Instagram foreground event regardless of classifier result, including DM and unknown surfaces, and displays only the classifier enum and REPORT CAPTURED or REPORT UNAVAILABLE. After a production gate is successfully admitted for display, another production gate cannot start for one minute; this monotonic cooldown is in memory only and may reset with process or service recreation. A positively identified direct return to Doom preserves the latest report only after the overlay detaches; other Doom-owned overlay events and foreign apps do not trigger preservation, and safety paths clear it. It never keeps UI text, descriptions, notification content, account data, screenshots, raw trees, bounds, or node/window IDs, and never logs, persists, uploads, or performs Instagram node actions except the explicit Skip action described below. Skip to messages removes the overlay first, then queries only the exact direct_tab ID in the current Instagram root; exactly one visible, enabled, clickable, unselected match may receive one ACTION_CLICK, while selected, missing, foreign, ambiguous, stale, failed, or exceptional cases fail closed. No success is claimed. Copy current report is shown only when current consent, connection and report permit it, and sends the current sanitized report to the system clipboard without showing it in the overlay. Turn off either consent at any time.
